title: About the studio
description: Studio history, teaching approach and community.
body:
Dance Institute brings technical dance training into a friendly, encouraging studio. Our goal is a well-rounded dance education that builds confidence, poise and a lasting love of movement.

A little of everything
Combination classes teach several dance styles in one class, leaving room for other interests.
Parents are part of it
Watch from the designated viewing area and connect through the Dance Institute Parent Organization.
Connected to our community
Students perform at community events, retirement homes and the annual June recital.
A year of progress
The school year runs from September through June. Summer workshops give new and returning dancers more time in the studio.

title: Studio policies
description: Clothing, shoes, hair and classroom guidelines.
body:
Before class

Bring the right dance shoes and a closed water bottle. Dancewear is available through the studio.

Clothing
The studio lists black short-sleeve leotards and pink tights for girls through age nine. Leotards and tights are the base attire; ballet skirts and dance pants for jazz, tap and hip-hop are welcome. Boys may wear dance pants and a T-shirt. Clothing should allow movement without being loose or baggy.
Hair
Keep hair away from the face. A bun works well for long hair; pigtails are recommended for tumbling.
In the studio
Follow your teacher’s directions. No hanging on ballet barres, chewing gum or wearing jewelry. Unsafe behavior may mean sitting out.
Watching class
Parents are welcome in the viewing area. Please keep conversations outside the class.
Ask about class attire ↗

title: Teachers
body:
Miss Michele

Michele began dancing at three and assisting in ballet, jazz, tap and tumbling classes at fourteen. Her teaching combines careful technique with a playful atmosphere that adapts to each age group.

She studied at the University of Minnesota, where she performed, choreographed and assisted with tap and ballroom courses. Her training spans ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop, modern, tumbling and ballroom.

Dance Institute has been family-owned and operated since opening in 2005.

title: The Nutcracker
body:
Dance Institute’s Nutcracker brings dancers together for ballet, rehearsals and performance. Contact the studio for this season’s audition details, rehearsal times and fees.

Who can audition?
The studio’s published audition information welcomes dancers ages eight and older.
What happens?
Dancers learn a short ballet routine and perform for the teaching panel, individually or in small groups. These are placement auditions to assign roles.
What should I wear?
Arrive in fitted dance clothing with hair secured. Ask the studio if you need help preparing.
Rehearsals & registration
Rehearsal commitments depend on the role. Confirm the current schedule with the studio and look for registration under Camps/Events in Sawyer.

title: Privacy policy
description: Studio SMS privacy and messaging information.
body:
This page summarizes Dance Institute, LLC’s published SMS terms.

Information & use

SMS signup may collect your name, email, mailing address and phone number through forms, email, rental agreements or reservation systems. Data is used for studio service messages, stored securely and retained while subscribed. You may request deletion at any time.

Messages & charges

Messages recur at varying frequencies. Carrier message and data charges may apply. Carriers are not responsible for delayed or undelivered messages.

Help & opting out

Reply HELP for assistance. Reply STOP or UNSUBSCRIBE to opt out, or contact the studio at (303) 525-0011. The studio sends a final confirmation and removes your number within 24 hours.

Sharing

Mobile information is not shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing. SMS consent and opt-in information are not shared. Information may be shared with subcontractors providing support services.
